Card Q&A.a: You can use this card, but no effect will occur. This will still trigger any effects that trigger when you use Option cards, however.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card when I don’t have a Digimon with [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] in play? If I can, what does the effect do?

Effect: [Main] If you have a Digimon with [Hybrid] or [Ten Warriors] in its traits in play, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
Security Effect: [Security] Add this card to its owner's hand.
